question:
A transformer has iron loss (core loss) $P_i=200\,\text{W}$ (approximately constant for a given supply voltage and frequency). The copper loss at full-load current is $P_{cu,FL}=450\,\text{W}$.

A student claims:

"The efficiency of the transformer will be maximum at full load because output power is maximum then."

Evaluate this claim by determining the fraction $x$ of full-load current at which the efficiency is maximum.
